messages:
alex: Vendor updated PO#A-4721 — new ETA for H100 batch moved to 6-8 weeks (was 2). Attached quote shows 10% warranty credit for DOA units if we accept delay. Thoughts? @mira @jordan

mira: yikes. that kills a chunk of EU reserved capacity. how many H100s on that PO?

alex: 40 units total, 8 marked DOA from last ramp. this PO feeds Dedicated pool in eu-west-1.

jordan: If we take credit we need a mitigation plan: loaner pool + temporary routing to hosted for critical customers. what's the monthly loaner cost?

sam: rough ballpark for 8 loaners + shipping/insurance is ~120k/month. could be reduced if we rotate older A800s as stopgap.

procurement-bot: Vendor message pasted:
```
Vendor (atlas-logistics): We can stagger 12 units for expedited ship in 2 weeks for +$45k, remainder 6-8 weeks. Alternatively accept 10% warranty credit and full 6-8 week ship. Open to discussing partial expedite.
```

mira: partial expedite + rotate A800s sounds workable. but customs in NL have been flaky lately — warehouse-eu can HSCODE changes add extra days? @warehouse-eu

warehouse-eu: yes — changing invoice/class triggers review sometimes 3-5 business days. also need serial manifest up front for RMA inbound to avoid quarantine.

jordan: ok action items: 1) @mira negotiate expedite on 12 units and push manifest before ship 2) @alex evaluate accepting 10% credit if expedite fails 3) i'll open a capacity fallback to route highest-SLA customers to hosted endpoints and throttle others.

alex: agree. @mira if vendor won't expedite, push for enhanced warranty credit tied to quicker RMA turnaround (e.g., 20% if replacement >6w and vendor covers loaner fees).

mira: i'll ask for that and also request vendor-provided loaners while they fulfill. will share vendor reply.

procurement-bot: draft email for negotiation (feel free to paste/edit):
```
Hi Atlas team,
we appreciate the update. To keep our contracts healthy and avoid customer impact we need one of the following:
1) expedite 12 units within 14 days (we accept expedite fee) and stagger remainder; OR
2) full warranty credit of 20% plus vendor-paid loaner coverage for DOA units until replacements delivered.
Please confirm serial manifest timeline and who will handle customs docs for EU inbound.
Thanks,
Procurement (Redwood)
```

sam: add: include clause that vendor covers return shipping for DOA and any customs reclassification fees.

jordan: i'll start a short-lived routing policy change tonight (low risk) and notify SRE.

alex: thanks. keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:

mira: pinging vendor now. will report within 12 hours. :wave:
